pairs.question: Quae scopulos tormenta rotant? Quae tanta cavernas vis glomerat? Quo fonte ruit Vulcanius amnis?
pairs.answer: Sive quod obicibus discurrens ventus opertis offenso rimosa furit per saxa meatu, dum scrutatur iter, libertatemque reposcens putria multivagis populatur flatibus antra; seu mare sulphurei ductum per viscera montis oppressis ignescit aquis et pondera librat.
pairs.derivation: Authorial-rhetorical: the poet asks what forces drive Etna's eruptions (three questions, 1.170-171) and answers them himself with a two-part explanation (sive ventus... / seu mare..., 1.172-177). Inline verse numbers (170, 175) stripped. Answer kept whole through the second alternative ending at 'pondera librat.' (full stop, 1.177); the next sentence 'Hic ubi servandum mater fidissima pignus abdidit...' returns to narrative and is excluded. No non-answering preamble to skip. Capitalization of 'Quo' normalized at sentence start.
